_comment: One-time structured extraction of every dataset/media/images/*.png referenced by a blank-amount financial event, per implementation/phase5.md Part 3/31 ('extract once, cache, reuse'). Each entry is exactly the shape a vision model call would return: {amount, currency, confidence, evidence_text}. No live model/API call is made at runtime; CachedVisionExtractor in code/evidence.py looks these up by image_id. image_04's amount is genuinely unresolved because the visible receipt total is cut off before a final grand total; it is intentionally omitted rather than guessed.

image_01.evidence_text: Pay Slip Aug-2019 (HR Department, M NURHUDA SY): Net Pay = IDR 4,365,000, transferred to Bank Central Asia.

image_02.evidence_text: Rent Receipt #9453: Total Amount to be Received 2,00,000.00; Amount Received 1,00,000.00; Balance Due 1,00,000.00 -- the outstanding balance matches the event description 'Outstanding rent balance'.

image_03.evidence_text: Riddhi Siddhi (Nuts and Spices) Bill of Supply #1125000158: Net Amount 41272.0, Cash Paid 41272.00.

image_04.evidence_text: Delivery app order screenshot shows 'Item Bill ₹2854.00' but the total order bill section is cropped before a final grand total (a further 'Delivery ...' line is visible but cut off) -- the true total cannot be reliably read from this image.

image_05.evidence_text: Airtel account summary: 'Amount due till 06-Feb-2026 = 704.05' (the outstanding telecom bill; a higher post-due-date amount of 822.05 also appears but is the late/penalty figure, not the current outstanding bill).

image_06.evidence_text: Blink Commerce (Grofers) GST invoice: Total INR 1995.00 ('One Thousand And Nine Hundred And Ninety-Five Rupees').

image_07.evidence_text: Nagarjuna 1984 KMR tax invoice: SubTotal 8122.00 + taxes = 8528.10, with 'Grand Total (RS): 8528' as the final settled/rounded figure.

image_08.evidence_text: Society maintenance payment receipt: 'Total Amount Received ₹ 15,339.00' via ICICI Bank/paytm, against Invoice 6455.

image_09.evidence_text: Water bill payment receipt: 'Total Amount Received ₹ 723.00' against Invoice 6320.

image_10.evidence_text: Grocery GST invoice: Sub Total 72,045.00 plus taxes, 'Total ₹79,679.26', 'Balance Due ₹79,679.26'.

image_11.evidence_text: Jeevan Hospital provisional bill: 'Total Bill Amount: 3650.00', 'Amount Payable: 3650.00', 'Amount Paid: 0.00', 'Balance: 3650.00' -- matches the event description 'Hospital bill payable'.

image_12.evidence_text: CityCab Service taxi receipt: Subtotal $33.50, Tax $0.00, Total $33.50 (cash paid $40.00, change $6.50).

image_13.evidence_text: DailyObjects order confirmation: Item Total (2 items) ₹2,298, Delivery Free, 'Total paid ₹2,298'.

image_14.evidence_text: Handwritten pharmacy receipt: line items (Samhan 1500, Moov spray 724, Axe oil 796, Stayfree 550, Benadryl 303, plus 670) sum to 4543.00; the handwritten 'TOTAL' figure itself is not cleanly legible, so the itemized sum is used as the corroborated best estimate rather than the ambiguous handwriting alone.

image_15.evidence_text: IndiGo (InterGlobe Aviation) tax invoice, PNR UC83TT: 'Currency: INR', Grand Total (Incl Taxes) = 9,968.00.

image_16.evidence_text: EV charging station invoice (Krishnagiri, Tamil Nadu): Total 393.22 ('Three Hundred and Ninety Three Rupees And Twenty Two Paise').
